FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/service/StepCounterService.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.service

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEvent
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.myapp.adventure.MainActivity
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

class StepCounterService : Service(), SensorEventListener {

    companion object {
        /** Hint for UI only. Never gate startForeground() on this. */
        var isRunning = false

        /** Last raw absolute reading from the sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var absoluteSteps: Int = 0
            private set

        /** True once at least one sensor event has been received in this process. */
        @Volatile
        var hasFirstEvent: Boolean = false
            private set

        /** True if this device has a TYPE_STEP_COUNTER sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var isSensorAvailable: Boolean = false
            private set

        private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_counter_service_prefs"
        private const val KEY_LAST_RAW = "last_raw_value"
    }

    private lateinit var sensorManager: SensorManager
    private var stepSensor: Sensor? = null
    private var isListening = false

    // ----- Baseline / delta tracking (accessed from onSensorChanged) -----

    /**
     * Last raw value we've seen. Loaded from prefs on start so a process restart
     * (without reboot) doesn't lose the baseline.
     * -1 means "unknown".
     */
    @Volatile
    private var lastRawSteps: Int = -1

    /** True once we have a valid baseline. */
    @Volatile
    private var hasBaseline: Boolean = false

    /** Accumulated delta waiting to be flushed by the background worker. */
    private val pendingDelta = AtomicInteger(0)

    /** Set by onSensorChanged when a sensor reboot is detected; consumed in the worker. */
    private val rebootDetected = AtomicBoolean(false)

    // ----- Background worker -----

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var workerJob: Job? = null

    // ==================== Lifecycle ====================

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()

        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (folderUriString != null) {
            Logger.init(applicationContext, folderUriString)
        }

        createNotificationChannel()

        sensorManager = getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager
        stepSensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER)
        isSensorAvailable = stepSensor != null

        val savedRaw = loadLastRaw()
        if (savedRaw >= 0) {
            lastRawSteps = savedRaw
            hasBaseline = true
        }

        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "StepCounterService created, sensor: ${if (isSensorAvailable) "available" else "MISSING"}, " +
                    "savedRaw=$savedRaw"
        )
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "onStartCommand: action=${intent?.action}, isRunning=$isRunning, isListening=$isListening"
        )

        when (intent?.action) {
            StepCounterConstants.ACTION_STOP -> {
                Logger.log(applicationContext, "ACTION_STOP received, stopping service")
                shutdown()
                return START_NOT_STICKY
            }
            else -> {
                // ACTION_START, null (START_STICKY restart), or unknown action.
                // Android 14+ requires a runtime prerequisite for the `health`
                // foreground-service type; without it startForeground() throws
                // SecurityException and kills the process. See:
                // https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/services/fgs/launch
                if (!hasActivityRecognitionPermission()) {
                    Logger.log(
                        applicationContext,
                        "ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION not granted; not starting foreground service"
                    )
                    stopSelf()
                    return START_NOT_STICKY
                }
                // startForeground is idempotent; Android 12+ requires it within 5s.
                startForeground(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, buildNotificationStatic())
                isRunning = true

                if (!isListening && stepSensor != null) {
                    sensorManager.registerListener(
                        this,
                        stepSensor,
                        SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_NORMAL
                    )
                    isListening = true
                    Logger.log(applicationContext, "Sensor listener registered")
                }

                startWorker()
            }
        }
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onDestroy() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        isRunning = false
        Logger.log(applicationContext, "StepCounterService destroyed")
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // ==================== Sensor ====================

    override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent?) {
        if (event?.sensor?.type != Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER) return

        val raw = event.values[0].toInt()
        absoluteSteps = raw
        hasFirstEvent = true

        // Sensor reboot detection: a fresh boot resets the counter to a small value.
        if (hasBaseline && raw < lastRawSteps) {
            lastRawSteps = raw
            saveLastRaw(raw)
            pendingDelta.set(0)
            rebootDetected.set(true)
            broadcastUpdate(raw, 0)
            return
        }

        val delta = if (hasBaseline) (raw - lastRawSteps).coerceAtLeast(0) else 0
        if (!hasBaseline) {
            hasBaseline = true
        }
        lastRawSteps = raw
        saveLastRaw(raw)

        if (delta > 0) {
            pendingDelta.addAndGet(delta)
        }

        broadcastUpdate(raw, delta)
    }

    override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) {}

    private fun broadcastUpdate(raw: Int, delta: Int) {
        sendBroadcast(
            Intent(StepCounterConstants.ACTION_UPDATE).apply {
                setPackage(packageName)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_ABSOLUTE_STEPS, raw)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_DELTA, delta)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_SENSOR_AVAILABLE, isSensorAvailable)
            }
        )
    }

    private fun stopListening() {
        if (isListening) {
            sensorManager.unregisterListener(this)
            isListening = false
        }
    }

    /**
     * True if the app may legally start a `health` foreground service on this
     * device. From Android 10 (API 29) the `ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION` runtime
     * permission is the prerequisite; on API 34+ the system enforces it by
     * throwing SecurityException from startForeground().
     */
    private fun hasActivityRecognitionPermission(): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) return true
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            this, Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    // ==================== Background worker ====================

    /**
     * Runs while the service is in foreground.
     * Every 1.5s drains pendingDelta into StepHistoryManager, every ~15s refreshes the notification.
     * Does NOT touch the sensor.
     */
    private fun startWorker() {
        stopWorker()
        workerJob = scope.launch {
            var ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
            while (isActive) {
                delay(1_500L)

                val delta = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
                if (delta > 0) {
                    try {
                        StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, delta)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        Logger.log(applicationContext, "recordDelta failed: ${e.message}")
                    }
                }

                if (rebootDetected.compareAndSet(true, false)) {
                    Logger.log(
                        applicationContext,
                        "Sensor reboot detected, baseline reset to $lastRawSteps"
                    )
                }

                ticksSinceNotifUpdate++
                if (ticksSinceNotifUpdate >= 10) {
                    ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
                    refreshNotificationContent()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun stopWorker() {
        workerJob?.cancel()
        workerJob = null
    }

    private fun shutdown() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        // Try to flush the last pending delta before stopping.
        val tail = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
        if (tail > 0) {
            scope.launch {
                try {
                    StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, tail)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                }
            }
        }
        isRunning = false
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
        stopSelf()
    }

    // ==================== Notification ====================

    /** Static notification used to satisfy startForeground() within 5s. */
    private fun buildNotificationStatic(): Notification {
        val text = when {
            !isSensorAvailable -> getString(R.string.step_service_sensor_unavailable)
            !hasFirstEvent -> getString(R.string.step_service_waiting_for_sensor)
            else -> getString(R.string.step_service_tracking_active)
        }
        return newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()
    }

    private fun refreshNotificationContent() {
        if (!isRunning) return

        val todaySteps = try {
            StepHistoryManager.getTodaySteps(applicationContext)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            0
        }

        val text = when {
            !isSensorAvailable -> getString(R.string.step_service_sensor_unavailable)
            !hasFirstEvent -> getString(R.string.step_service_waiting_for_sensor)
            else -> {
                val stepsText = com.myapp.adventure.utils.ruQuantityString(
                    this, com.myapp.adventure.R.plurals.steps, todaySteps
                )
                getString(R.string.step_service_today_steps_fmt, stepsText)
            }
        }

        val notification = newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()

        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.notify(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
    }

    private fun newNotificationBuilder(): NotificationCompat.Builder {
        val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle(getString(R.string.step_service_notification_title))
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
            .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        val channel = NotificationChannel(
            StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID,
            getString(R.string.step_service_channel_name),
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
        )
        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
    }

    // ==================== Baseline persistence ====================

    private fun saveLastRaw(value: Int) {
        try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, value)
                .apply()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }

    private fun loadLastRaw(): Int {
        return try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, -1)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            -1
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/HealthConnectStepSource.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import androidx.health.connect.client.HealthConnectClient
import androidx.health.connect.client.permission.HealthPermission
import androidx.health.connect.client.records.StepsRecord
import androidx.health.connect.client.request.AggregateRequest
import androidx.health.connect.client.time.TimeRangeFilter
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.ZoneId

/**
 * Health Connect step source.
 *
 * Reads aggregate step count for "today" from Health Connect. The first call
 * establishes a baseline (today's total at that moment). Each subsequent call
 * returns the difference between today's total and the baseline.
 *
 * Data may arrive with a delay: Health Connect aggregates records written by
 * other apps, and Google recommends not writing more than once every 15 min.
 * So the game gate may update with a lag — we document this in UI.
 */
class HealthConnectStepSource : StepSource {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "HealthConnectStepSource"
        const val PROVIDER_PACKAGE = "com.google.android.apps.healthdata"
    }

    override val id: String = "health_connect"

    // Baseline: today's aggregate at the moment we started using HC for this day.
    @Volatile private var baselineDate: String? = null
    @Volatile private var baselineTotal: Long = 0L
    @Volatile private var lastSeenTotal: Long = 0L

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        val status = HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context, PROVIDER_PACKAGE)
        if (status != HealthConnectClient.SDK_AVAILABLE) return false
        return true
    }

    suspend fun hasReadPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val granted = client.permissionController.getGrantedPermissions()
            granted.contains(HealthPermission.getReadPermission(StepsRecord::class))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: permission check failed: ${e.message}")
            false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        if (!hasReadPermission(context)) return 0

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val todayKey = today.toString()

        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
            val start = today.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant()
            val end = Instant.now()

            val response = client.aggregate(
                AggregateRequest(
                    metrics = setOf(StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL),
                    timeRangeFilter = TimeRangeFilter.between(start, end)
                )
            )
            val total = response[StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL] ?: 0L

            if (baselineDate != todayKey) {
                // First read today (or first read after day rollover).
                baselineDate = todayKey
                baselineTotal = total
                lastSeenTotal = total
                Logger.log(context, "$TAG: baseline for $todayKey = $total")
                return 0
            }

            val delta = (total - lastSeenTotal).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            lastSeenTotal = total
            if (delta > 0) Logger.log(context, "$TAG: delta=$delta (total=$total)")
            delta.toInt()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: aggregate failed: ${e.message}")
            0
        }
    }

    /** Called by StepSourceManager on day rollover to reset baseline. */
    fun onDayChanged() {
        baselineDate = null
        baselineTotal = 0L
        lastSeenTotal = 0L
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterService

/**
 * Wraps [StepCounterService] as a [StepSource].
 *
 * The service already accumulates a delta in [StepCounterService] and writes
 * to [StepHistoryManager]. To avoid double-counting, this source does NOT
 * call recordDelta itself — it only reports what the service has accumulated
 * since the last poll via [consumePendingDelta].
 *
 * Note: StepCounterService writes to StepHistoryManager independently, so this
 * source's delta is informational for the manager (used to compare with HC).
 * The manager applies max-per-bucket semantics when both sources report.
 */
class SensorStepSource : StepSource {

    override val id: String = "sensor"

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        return StepCounterService.isSensorAvailable
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        // Sensor source does not push deltas through StepSourceManager;
        // StepCounterService already writes them directly.
        // Returning 0 keeps StepSourceManager idempotent.
        return 0
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/StepSource.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Abstraction over a step data source.
 *
 * Implementations must be cheap to construct. Heavy initialization belongs
 * in [StepSourceManager].
 */
interface StepSource {

    /** Stable identifier used for logging and prefs. */
    val id: String

    /**
     * Whether this source can currently be used.
     * For Health Connect this checks [HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus] and
     * whether the READ_STEPS permission has been granted.
     */
    fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean

    /**
     * Delta (steps) since the previous call. Return 0 if nothing new.
     *
     * Implementations must handle their own baseline internally. For the sensor
     * source, delta is derived from [StepCounterService] events. For Health
     * Connect, delta is derived from aggregate calls over a sliding window.
     */
    suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/StepSourceManager.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Chooses the active step source and polls it periodically.
 *
 * - If user preference is "health_connect" AND HC is available AND permission granted
 *   → polls HealthConnectStepSource.
 * - Otherwise → SensorStepSource (passive; StepCounterService already writes deltas).
 *
 * Polling interval is 60 seconds. Health Connect may lag, so the gate in
 * AdventureReaderFragment updates with a delay when HC is active. This is documented in UI.
 */
object StepSourceManager {

    private const val TAG = "StepSourceManager"
    private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_source_prefs"
    private const val KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT = "use_health_connect"
    private const val POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000L

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var pollJob: Job? = null

    private val sensorSource = SensorStepSource()
    private val healthConnectSource = HealthConnectStepSource()

    // ----- User preference -----

    fun isHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, false)
    }

    fun setHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context, enabled: Boolean) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, enabled).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "$TAG: Health Connect enabled=$enabled")
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    /**
     * True if the user enabled HC AND HC is currently usable (installed + permission granted).
     * UI uses this to decide whether to show "updating every N minutes" hint.
     */
    fun isHealthConnectActive(context: Context): Boolean {
        if (!isHealthConnectEnabled(context)) return false
        if (!healthConnectSource.isAvailable(context)) return false
        // Permission check is suspend; we use a lightweight synchronous heuristic here.
        // The actual check happens on each poll; if permission is missing, getDelta returns 0
        // and the source falls back to sensor on the next poll.
        return true
    }

    // ----- Lifecycle -----

    /** Call from SetupFragment / MainActivity once per process. */
    fun start(context: Context) {
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    fun stop() {
        pollJob?.cancel()
        pollJob = null
    }

    private fun restartPolling(appContext: Context) {
        stop()
        pollJob = scope.launch {
            while (isActive) {
                try {
                    pollOnce(appContext)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: poll failed: ${e.message}")
                }
                delay(POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun pollOnce(appContext: Context) {
        val useHc = isHealthConnectEnabled(appContext) &&
                healthConnectSource.isAvailable(appContext) &&
                healthConnectSource.hasReadPermission(appContext)

        if (!useHc) {
            // Sensor source writes deltas directly via StepCounterService.
            // Nothing to push here.
            return
        }

        val delta = healthConnectSource.getDelta(appContext)
        if (delta > 0) {
            // Use applyBucketMax through a public wrapper (see StepHistoryManager patch below).
            StepHistoryManager.applyHealthConnectDelta(appContext, delta)
            Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: HC delta=$delta applied")
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui.editor

import android.app.AlertDialog

class AdventureEditorFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentAdventureEditorBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    private lateinit var viewModel: AdventureEditorViewModel

    private val debounceHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val saveRunnable = Runnable { saveDraftImmediate() }

    private val openFileLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) loadFromUri(uri)
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(AdventureEditorViewModel::class.java)
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentAdventureEditorBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        applyWindowInsetsToRoot(view)

        binding.composeToolbar.setContent {
            AdventureTheme {
                val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                EditorToolbar(
                    state = state,
                    onMenuClick = {
                        parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                            .replace(R.id.fragment_container, MenuFragment())
                            .addToBackStack(null)
                            .commit()
                    },
                    onToggleActions = { viewModel.toggleMenuExpanded() },
                    onUndo = { performUndo() },
                    onRedo = { performRedo() },
                    onAddScene = {
                        viewModel.addScene()
                        viewModel.commitSnapshot()
                        markDirty()
                    },
                    onSave = { saveAdventure() },
                    onLoad = { openFileLauncher.launch(arrayOf("application/json")) },
                    onEditMeta = { openEditMetaDialog() },
                    onValidate = { showValidationDialog() },
                    onSearch = { showSearchDialog() },
                    onStats = { showStatsDialog() },
                    onTemplates = {
                        parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                            .replace(R.id.fragment_container, TemplateListFragment())
                            .addToBackStack(null)
                            .commit()
                    },
                )
            }
        }

        val dirtyCallback: (Boolean) -> Unit = { structural ->
            if (structural) viewModel.commitSnapshot()
            markDirty()
        }

        binding.composeBody.setContent {
            AdventureTheme {
                EditorScenesList(
                    viewModel = viewModel,
                    onDirty = dirtyCallback,
                    onPreviewScene = { uid -> openPreview(uid) },
                )
            }
        }

        viewModel.commitState()

        maybeRestoreDraft()

        if (!viewModel.isHistoryInitialized()) {
            viewModel.initHistory()
        }
    }

    private fun applyWindowInsetsToRoot(view: View) {
        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(view) { v, insets ->
            val i = insets.getInsets(
                WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars() or
                        WindowInsetsCompat.Type.displayCutout()
            )
            v.setPadding(i.left, i.top, i.right, i.bottom)
            insets
        }
    }

    // ---------- Редактирование названия ----------

    private fun openEditMetaDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_edit_meta, null)
        val etTitle = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_title)
        val etAuthor = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_author)
        val etDesc = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_description)

        etTitle.setText(viewModel.title)
        etAuthor.setText(viewModel.author)
        etDesc.setText(viewModel.description)

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_edit_meta_title)
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_apply) { _, _ ->
                viewModel.title = etTitle.text.toString().trim()
                viewModel.author = etAuthor.text.toString().trim()
                viewModel.description = etDesc.text.toString().trim()
                markDirty()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(R.string.dialog_cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    // ---------- Undo / Redo ----------

    private fun performUndo() {
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        if (viewModel.uiState.value.hasUnsavedChanges) viewModel.commitSnapshot()
        if (!viewModel.undo()) return
        saveDraftImmediate()
        viewModel.commitState()
    }

    private fun performRedo() {
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        if (!viewModel.redo()) return
        saveDraftImmediate()
        viewModel.commitState()
    }

    // ---------- Debounce-автосохранение ----------

    private fun markDirty() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        viewModel.setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
        viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.EDITING)
        viewModel.commitState()
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        debounceHandler.postDelayed(saveRunnable, DEBOUNCE_MS)
    }

    private fun saveDraftImmediate() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.SAVING)

        viewModel.commitSnapshot()
        EditorDraftManager.saveDraft(
            requireContext(),
            viewModel.title,
            viewModel.author,
            viewModel.description,
            viewModel.variables,
            viewModel.templates,
            viewModel.initialStateTags,
            viewModel.scenes
        )
        viewModel.setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
        viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.SAVED)
        Logger.log(requireContext(), "Черновик автосохранён, сцен: ${viewModel.scenes.size}")
    }

    // ---------- Восстановление черновика ----------

    private fun maybeRestoreDraft() {
        if (viewModel.scenes.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.title.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.author.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.description.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.initialStateTags.isNotEmpty()
        ) return

        val draft = EditorDraftManager.loadDraft(requireContext()) ?: return
        if (draft.scenes.isEmpty() && draft.title.isEmpty() && draft.initialStateTags.isEmpty()) {
            EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            return
        }

        val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("d MMMM, HH:mm", Locale.getDefault())
        val draftDateStr = dateFormat.format(Date(draft.savedAt))

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_restore_draft_title)
            .setMessage(
                getString(
                    R.string.editor_draft_restore_message_fmt,
                    draftDateStr,
                    draft.scenes.size
                )
            )
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_restore) { _, _ ->
                viewModel.title = draft.title
                viewModel.author = draft.author
                viewModel.description = draft.description
                viewModel.variables.clear()
                viewModel.variables.addAll(draft.variables.map { it.copy() })
                viewModel.templates.clear()
                viewModel.templates.addAll(draft.templates.map { it.deepCopy() })
                viewModel.initialStateTags.clear()
                viewModel.initialStateTags.addAll(draft.initialStateTags.map { it.copy() })
                viewModel.scenes.clear()
                viewModel.scenes.addAll(draft.scenes.map { it.deepCopy() })

                viewModel.initHistory()
                viewModel.collapseAllScenes()
                viewModel.collapseAllChoices()
                viewModel.commitState()

                viewModel.setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
                viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.SAVED)
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Черновик восстановлен, сцен: ${draft.scenes.size}")
            }
            .setNegativeButton(R.string.dialog_delete) { _, _ ->
                EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            }
            .show()
    }

    // ---------- Загрузка из файла ----------

    private fun loadFromUri(uri: Uri) {
        try {
            val inputStream = requireContext().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
            val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inputStream))
            val json = reader.readText()
            reader.close()
            val adventure = Gson().fromJson(json, Adventure::class.java)

            debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
            EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            viewModel.setHasUnsavedChanges(false)

            viewModel.title = adventure.title
            viewModel.author = adventure.author
            viewModel.description = adventure.description
            viewModel.scenes.clear()

            viewModel.variables.clear()
            adventure.variables?.forEach { (name, dto) ->
                viewModel.variables.add(viewModel.editorVarDeclFromDto(name, dto))
            }

            viewModel.templates.clear()
            adventure.choiceTemplates?.forEach { dto ->
                viewModel.templates.add(viewModel.editorTemplateFromDto(dto))
            }
            if (viewModel.variables.isEmpty()) {
                AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_types_missing_title)
                    .setMessage(R.string.editor_dialog_types_missing_message)
                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_declare) { _, _ ->
                        viewModel.updateVariablesExpanded(true)
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton(R.string.dialog_later, null)
                    .show()
            }

            val tagDefs = adventure.tags.orEmpty().associateBy { it.name }

            viewModel.initialStateTags.clear()
            val init = adventure.initialState
            if (init != null) {
                init.flags?.forEach { flag ->
                    val def = tagDefs[flag]
                    viewModel.initialStateTags.add(
                        EditorTag(
                            name = flag,
                            value = 0,
                            isStatModifier = false,
                            category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL,
                            displayName = def?.displayName ?: flag,
                            visible = def?.visible ?: false
                        )
                    )
                }
                init.stats?.forEach { (name, value) ->
                    val def = tagDefs[name]
                    val cat = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL
                    viewModel.initialStateTags.add(
                        EditorTag(
                            name = name,
                            value = value,
                            isStatModifier = true,
                            category = cat,
                            displayName = def?.displayName ?: name,
                            visible = def?.visible ?: false
                        )
                    )
                }
            }

            val allChapters = adventure.chapters.orEmpty()
            for ((chapterIndex, chapter) in allChapters.withIndex()) {
                val scenes = chapter.scenes.orEmpty()
                val v1GateForLastScene =
                    allChapters.getOrNull(chapterIndex + 1)?.requiredSteps ?: 0
                for ((sceneIndex, scene) in scenes.withIndex()) {
                    val isLastInChapter = sceneIndex == scenes.lastIndex
                    val v5Gate = scene.gate ?: 0
                    val effectiveGate =
                        if (v5Gate > 0) v5Gate
                        else if (isLastInChapter) v1GateForLastScene
                        else 0
                    val editorScene = EditorScene(
                        id = scene.id,
                        idIsAuto = false,
                        title = scene.id,
                        text = scene.text,
                        isChapterEnd = isLastInChapter,
                        gateRequiredSteps = effectiveGate,
                        gateRepeatable = scene.gateRepeatable ?: false,
                        isEnding = scene.isEnding ?: false,
                        isMerge = scene.merge ?: false,
                        mergeSources = scene.mergeSources ?: emptyList(),
                        tags = extractTags(scene, tagDefs),
                        choices = scene.choices?.map { choice ->
                            EditorChoice(
                                text = choice.text,
                                nextSceneId = choice.nextScene,
                                conditionTag = choice.condition ?: "",
                                visibilityConditionTag = choice.visibilityCondition ?: "",
                                tags = extractChoiceTags(choice, tagDefs),
                                templateUid = choice.templateRef?.templateId,
                                templateArgs = choice.templateRef?.args ?: emptyMap(),
                            )
                        }?.toMutableList() ?: mutableListOf()
                    )
                    viewModel.scenes.add(editorScene)
                }
            }

            val deathDef = adventure.deathScene
            if (deathDef != null) {
                val existingScene = viewModel.scenes.find { it.id == deathDef.id }
                if (existingScene != null) {
                    existingScene.isDeathScene = true
                    existingScene.deathAllowStepBack = deathDef.allowStepBack
                    existingScene.deathAllowChapterRestart = deathDef.allowChapterRestart
                    existingScene.deathAllowAdventureRestart = deathDef.allowAdventureRestart
                } else {
                    val deathSceneEditor = EditorScene(
                        id = deathDef.id,
                        idIsAuto = false,
                        title = getString(R.string.item_editor_scene_death_scene),
                        text = deathDef.text,
                        isDeathScene = true,
                        deathAllowStepBack = deathDef.allowStepBack,
                        deathAllowChapterRestart = deathDef.allowChapterRestart,
                        deathAllowAdventureRestart = deathDef.allowAdventureRestart
                    )
                    viewModel.scenes.add(deathSceneEditor)
                }
            }

            viewModel.initHistory()
            viewModel.collapseAllScenes()
            viewModel.collapseAllChoices()
            viewModel.commitState()

            viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.LOADED)

            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Приключение загружено из файла: ${uri.lastPathSegment}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_loaded, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка загрузки приключения: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), getString(R.string.editor_toast_load_error, e.message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun extractTags(
        scene: com.myapp.adventure.data.Scene,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> = buildTagList(scene.setFlags, scene.removeFlags, scene.modifyStats, tagDefs)

    private fun extractChoiceTags(
        choice: com.myapp.adventure.data.Choice,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> = buildTagList(choice.setFlags, choice.removeFlags, choice.modifyStats, tagDefs)

    private fun buildTagList(
        setFlags: List<String>?,
        removeFlags: List<String>?,
        modifyStats: Map<String, Int>?,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> {
        val tags = mutableListOf<EditorTag>()
        for (flag in setFlags.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[flag]
            val category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL
            val value = if (category == TagCategory.ITEM) 1 else 0
            val isStat = category == TagCategory.ITEM
            tags.add(EditorTag(flag, value, isStat, category, def?.displayName ?: flag, def?.visible ?: false))
        }
        for (flag in removeFlags.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[flag]
            tags.add(EditorTag("!$flag", 0, false, def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL, def?.displayName ?: flag, def?.visible ?: false))
        }
        for ((stat, value) in modifyStats.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[stat]
            tags.add(EditorTag(stat, value, true, def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL, def?.displayName ?: stat, def?.visible ?: false))
        }
        return tags
    }

    // ---------- Сохранение в файл ----------

    private fun saveAdventure() {
        if (viewModel.scenes.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_add_scene_first, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        viewModel.freezeAllPendingIds()

        val adventure = viewModel.buildAdventure()
        val gson = com.google.gson.GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create()
        val json = gson.toJson(adventure)

        val prefs = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
        val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (folderUriString == null) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_folder_not_selected, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val folderUri = Uri.parse(folderUriString)

        try {
            val newAdventuresDirUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(
                folderUri,
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri) + "/NewAdventures"
            )
            val fileName = viewModel.transliterate(adventure.title.ifBlank { "adventure" }) + ".json"
            val existingFileUri = findFileInFolder(newAdventuresDirUri, fileName)

            var saved = false
            if (existingFileUri != null) {
                requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(existingFileUri, "wt")?.use {
                    it.write(json.toByteArray())
                }
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), getString(R.string.editor_toast_updated, fileName), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                saved = true
            } else {
                val newUri = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                    requireContext().contentResolver, newAdventuresDirUri, "application/json", fileName
                )
                if (newUri != null) {
                    requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(newUri)?.use {
                        it.write(json.toByteArray())
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(), getString(R.string.editor_toast_saved, fileName), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    saved = true
                }
            }

            if (saved) {
                EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
                viewModel.setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
                viewModel.setSaveStatus(SaveStatus.SAVED_TO_FILE)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка сохранения: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), getString(R.string.editor_toast_save_error, e.message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun findFileInFolder(folderUri: Uri, fileName: String): Uri? {
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri, DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        requireContext().contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val displayName = it.getString(it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME))
                if (displayName == fileName) {
                    val docId = it.getString(it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID))
                    return DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    // ---------- Валидатор ----------

    private fun showValidationDialog() {
        viewModel.freezeAllPendingIds()
        val (irAdventure, conditionParseErrors) = viewModel.buildIrAdventure()
        val issues = mutableListOf<ValidationIssue>()
        for (err in conditionParseErrors) {
            issues += ValidationIssue(
                severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                sceneUid = "",
                titleRes = R.string.validation_title_condition_parse_error,
                description = err.message,
            )
        }
        issues += StoryValidator.validate(irAdventure, viewModel.scenes)

        if (viewModel.variables.isEmpty()) {
            issues += ValidationIssue(
                severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                sceneUid = "",
                titleRes = R.string.validation_title_types_not_declared,
                description = getString(R.string.validation_desc_types_not_declared),
            )
        }

        if (issues.isEmpty()) {
            AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_health_title)
                .setMessage(R.string.editor_dialog_health_no_issues_message)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_close, null)
                .show()
            return
        }

        val errorCount = issues.count { it.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR }
        val warningCount = issues.count { it.severity == IssueSeverity.WARNING }

        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_validation_issues, null)
        val tvSummary = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_summary)
        val container = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_issues)

        val summaryParts = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (errorCount > 0) {
            summaryParts.add(getString(R.string.validation_summary_errors_fmt, errorCount))
        }
        if (warningCount > 0) {
            summaryParts.add(getString(R.string.validation_summary_warnings_fmt, warningCount))
        }
        tvSummary.text = summaryParts.joinToString(" • ")

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_health_title)
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_close, null)
            .create()

        val ordered = issues.filter { it.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR } +
                issues.filter { it.severity == IssueSeverity.WARNING }

        for (issue in ordered) {
            val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.item_validation_issue, container, false)
            val icon = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_severity_icon)
            val title = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_title)
            val desc = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_description)

            icon.text = if (issue.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR) "❌" else "⚠️"
            title.text = getString(issue.titleRes)
            desc.text = issue.description

            rowView.setOnClickListener {
                dialog.dismiss()
                jumpToScene(issue.sceneUid)
            }
            container.addView(rowView)
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    // ---------- Поиск ----------

    private fun showSearchDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_search, null)

        val etQuery = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_search_query)
        val cbTitles = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_titles)
        val cbTexts = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_texts)
        val cbChoices = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_choices)
        val cbTags = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_tags)
        val tvSummary = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_summary)
        val container = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_results)

        cbTitles.isChecked = true
        cbTexts.isChecked = true
        cbChoices.isChecked = true
        cbTags.isChecked = true

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_search_title)
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_close, null)
            .create()

        val searchHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        var searchRunnable: Runnable? = null

        fun runSearch() {
            val query = etQuery.text.toString()
            if (query.trim().length < 2) {
                tvSummary.text = getString(R.string.editor_search_enter_query)
                container.removeAllViews()
                return
            }

            val results = SearchService.search(
                scenes = viewModel.scenes,
                query = query,
                searchInTitles = cbTitles.isChecked,
                searchInTexts = cbTexts.isChecked,
                searchInChoices = cbChoices.isChecked,
                searchInTags = cbTags.isChecked,
                titleFallback = getString(R.string.label_without_title),
            )

            container.removeAllViews()

            if (results.isEmpty()) {
                tvSummary.text = getString(R.string.editor_search_nothing_found)
                return
            }

            val scenesCount = results.map { it.sceneUid }.distinct().size
            val totalMatches = results.sumOf { it.totalMatchesInField }

            val matchesText = formatMatchesCount(totalMatches)
            val scenesText = if (scenesCount > 1) {
                " " + formatScenesPrepositional(scenesCount)
            } else {
                ""
            }
            tvSummary.text = getString(R.string.editor_search_matches_fmt, matchesText + scenesText)

            for (result in results) {
                val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
                    .inflate(R.layout.item_search_result, container, false)
                val tvIcon = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_icon)
                val tvTitleDetail = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_title_detail)
                val tvContext = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_context)

                tvIcon.text = result.fieldType.icon

                val detailText = if (result.detailArg != null) {
                    getString(result.detailRes, result.detailArg)
                } else {
                    getString(result.detailRes)
                }
                val titleDetailText = buildString {
                    append(result.sceneTitle)
                    append("  ·  ")
                    append(detailText)
                    if (result.totalMatchesInField > 1) {
                        append(getString(R.string.editor_search_more_fmt, result.totalMatchesInField - 1))
                    }
                }
                val spannableTitle = SpannableString(titleDetailText)
                spannableTitle.setSpan(
                    StyleSpan(Typeface.BOLD),
                    0, result.sceneTitle.length,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                spannableTitle.setSpan(
                    ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#AAAAAA")),
                    result.sceneTitle.length, titleDetailText.length,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                tvTitleDetail.text = spannableTitle

                val contextText = "«…${result.contextBefore}${result.match}${result.contextAfter}…»"
                val spannableCtx = SpannableString(contextText)
                val matchStart = 2 + result.contextBefore.length
                val matchEnd = matchStart + result.match.length
                spannableCtx.setSpan(
                    BackgroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#FFC107")),
                    matchStart, matchEnd,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                spannableCtx.setSpan(
                    ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#000000")),
                    matchStart, matchEnd,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                tvContext.text = spannableCtx

                rowView.setOnClickListener {
                    dialog.dismiss()
                    searchHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
                    jumpToScene(result.sceneUid)
                }
                container.addView(rowView)
            }
        }

        val watcher = object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                searchRunnable?.let { searchHandler.removeCallbacks(it) }
                val r = Runnable { runSearch() }
                searchRunnable = r
                searchHandler.postDelayed(r, 300L)
            }
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, st: Int, c: Int, a: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, st: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {}
        }
        etQuery.addTextChangedListener(watcher)

        val filterListener = CompoundButton.OnCheckedChangeListener { _, _ -> runSearch() }
        cbTitles.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbTexts.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbChoices.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbTags.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)

        dialog.setOnDismissListener {
            searchHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        }

        dialog.show()
        etQuery.requestFocus()
        tvSummary.text = getString(R.string.editor_search_enter_query)
    }

    private fun formatMatchesCount(n: Int): String =
        resources.getQuantityString(R.plurals.word_matches, n, n)

    private fun formatScenesPrepositional(n: Int): String =
        resources.getQuantityString(R.plurals.word_scenes_in, n, n)

    // ---------- Статистика ----------

    private fun showStatsDialog() {
        val stats = StoryStatsService.calculate(
            viewModel.scenes,
            titleFallback = getString(R.string.label_without_title),
        )

        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_story_stats, null)

        val tvScenes = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_scenes)
        val tvWords = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_words)
        val tvChoices = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_choices)
        val tvChapters = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_chapters)
        val tvReading = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_reading_time)
        val tvAvg = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_avg)
        val tvLongest = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_longest)
        val tvShortest = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_shortest)
        val containerChapters = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_chapters)

        tvScenes.text = getString(
            R.string.editor_stats_scenes_fmt,
            formatInt(stats.totalScenes),
            formatScenes(stats.totalScenes)
        )
        tvWords.text = getString(R.string.editor_stats_words_fmt, formatInt(stats.totalWords))
        tvChoices.text = getString(R.string.editor_stats_choices_fmt, formatInt(stats.totalChoices))
        tvChapters.text = getString(R.string.editor_stats_chapters_fmt, formatInt(stats.totalChapters))

        tvReading.text = getString(
            R.string.editor_stats_reading_fmt,
            formatReadingTime(stats.estimatedReadingMinutes)
        )

        if (stats.totalScenes > 0) {
            tvAvg.text = getString(
                R.string.editor_stats_avg_fmt,
                formatWords(stats.avgWordsPerScene)
            )
            tvLongest.text = getString(
                R.string.editor_stats_longest_fmt,
                stats.longestSceneTitle,
                formatWords(stats.longestSceneWords)
            )
            tvShortest.text = getString(
                R.string.editor_stats_shortest_fmt,
                stats.shortestSceneTitle,
                formatWords(stats.shortestSceneWords)
            )
        } else {
            tvAvg.text = ""
            tvLongest.text = ""
            tvShortest.text = ""
        }

        containerChapters.removeAllViews()
        for (chapter in stats.chapters) {
            addChapterStatsRow(containerChapters, chapter)
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.editor_dialog_stats_title)
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_close, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun addChapterStatsRow(
        container: LinearLayout,
        chapter: ChapterStats
    ) {
        val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.item_chapter_stats, container, false)
        val tvTitle = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_title)
        val tvDetails = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_details)
        val tvSteps = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_steps)

        tvTitle.text = getString(R.string.editor_chapter_title_fmt, chapter.index)

        tvDetails.text = getString(
            R.string.editor_chapter_details_fmt,
            formatScenes(chapter.sceneCount),
            formatWords(chapter.wordCount),
            formatChoices(chapter.choiceCount)
        )

        if (chapter.isLast) {
            tvSteps.text = getString(R.string.editor_chapter_last)
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
        } else if (chapter.requiredSteps > 0) {
            tvSteps.text = getString(
                R.string.editor_chapter_next_steps_fmt,
                formatSteps(chapter.requiredSteps)
            )
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFC107"))
        } else {
            tvSteps.text = getString(R.string.editor_chapter_no_gate)
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
        }

        container.addView(rowView)
    }

    // ---------- Форматирование чисел и склонений ----------

    private fun formatScenes(n: Int): String =
        pluralWithNumber(requireContext(), R.plurals.word_scenes, n)

    private fun formatWords(n: Int): String =
        pluralWithNumber(requireContext(), R.plurals.word_words, n)

    private fun formatChoices(n: Int): String =
        pluralWithNumber(requireContext(), R.plurals.word_choices, n)

    private fun formatSteps(n: Int): String =
        pluralWithNumber(requireContext(), R.plurals.steps, n)

    private fun formatReadingTime(minutes: Int): String {
        if (minutes < 1) return getString(R.string.editor_stats_reading_less_than_minute)
        return pluralWithNumber(requireContext(), R.plurals.word_minutes, minutes)
    }

    // ---------- Прыжок к сцене (упрощённо) ----------

    private fun jumpToScene(uid: String) {
        if (_binding == null) return
        viewModel.requestJumpToScene(uid)
    }

    private fun openPreview(sceneUid: String) {
        val scene = viewModel.scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid } ?: return
        if (scene.title.isBlank()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_title_first, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        viewModel.freezeAllPendingIds()
        if (scene.id.isBlank()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_id_generate_failed, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val adventure = viewModel.buildAdventure()
        val gson = Gson()
        val chapterIndex = adventure.chapters?.indexOfFirst { ch ->
            ch.scenes?.any { it.id == scene.id } == true
        } ?: -1
        if (chapterIndex < 0) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.editor_toast_scene_not_found, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val fragment = AdventureReaderFragment().apply {
            arguments = Bundle().apply {
                putString("adventure_json", gson.toJson(adventure))
                putString("preview_scene_id", scene.id)
                putInt("preview_chapter_index", chapterIndex)
                putBoolean("preview_mode", true)
            }
        }
        parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
            .replace(R.id.fragment_container, fragment)
            .addToBackStack(null)
            .commit()
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)

        if (_binding != null && viewModel.uiState.value.hasUnsavedChanges && viewModel.scenes.isNotEmpty()) {
            EditorDraftManager.saveDraft(
                requireContext(),
                viewModel.title,
                viewModel.author,
                viewModel.description,
                viewModel.variables,
                viewModel.templates,
                viewModel.initialStateTags,
                viewModel.scenes
            )
        }
        _binding = null
    }

    companion object {
        private const val DEBOUNCE_MS = 400L
    }
}

import com.myapp.adventure.engine.ir.applyTemplate as irApplyTemplate

import com.myapp.adventure.engine.parse.ParseResult
